records.title: Efficient KV Cache Spillover Management on Memory-Constrained GPU for LLM Inference
records.reason: The DOI/title metadata identifies a paper on KV-cache spillover for constrained-GPU LLM inference, a directly relevant topic, but the IEEE primary abstract page could not be retrieved in this screening session; retain pending primary abstract evidence.

records.title: Path-Lock Expert: Separating Reasoning Mode in Hybrid Thinking via Architecture-Level Separation
records.reason: The paper separates think/no-think MLP experts, but its full text says inference keeps the same per-token computation pattern; shorter no-think answers may reduce total generated tokens, while serving-efficiency gains are not established.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: inference preserves the dense model’s per-token computation pattern

sections_read: A.13 Broader Impact and Future Applications: Conventional inference serving
body_review.finding: The architecture preserves the dense model’s per-token computation pattern. The paper reports shorter /no_think outputs but does not establish an inference-serving system speedup.

records.title: Federated Attention: A Distributed Paradigm for Collaborative LLM Inference over Edge Networks
records.reason: Federated Attention exchanges/aggregates KV matrices across participants to support collaborative LLM inference at the edge and analyzes the communication/computation trade-off.

records.title: Trinity: Three-Dimensional Tensor Program Optimization via Tile-level Equality Saturation
records.reason: Trinity jointly optimizes tensor algebra, tile-level memory operations, and compute orchestration in a compiler; its author-hosted primary paper connects these compiler optimizations to GPU kernels.
records.primary_source: author-hosted primary paper PDF; DOI/title cross-check via ACM bibliographic page

sections_read: Tile-level intermediate representation and equality saturation
body_review.finding: The paper presents tile-level compiler search across algebraic rewrites, memory access and compute scheduling, with tensor-program evaluation; this is a direct compiler/runtime foundation for efficient ML kernels.

records.title: Mosaic: Unlocking Long-Context Inference for Diffusion LLMs via Global Memory Planning and Dynamic Peak Taming
records.reason: Mosaic manages diffusion-LLM inference memory peaks with logits kernels, adaptive chunking, and global memory management, increasing supported context length while reducing latency.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: a memory-efficient inference system that shifts from local, static management to a global, dynamic paradigm

records.title: Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts with Two-Stage Optimization
records.reason: Hi-MoE separates inter-group load balancing from within-group specialization for sparse MoE routers and reports improved expert balance and model quality.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: decomposes routing control into two coupled levels

records.title: RouteNLP: Closed-Loop LLM Routing with Conformal Cascading and Distillation Co-Optimization
records.reason: RouteNLP combines difficulty-aware routing, conformal cascading, and targeted distillation; its pilot reports lower LLM inference cost and p99 latency.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: routes queries across a tiered model portfolio to minimize cost

records.title: Sublinear Time Quantum Algorithm for Attention Approximation
records.reason: This paper studies sublinear-time quantum approximation of the Transformer attention operation used by LLMs; it is a concrete algorithmic contribution to attention complexity.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: attention module is the backbone of modern transformers and large language models

records.title: Revisiting Parameter Server in LLM Post-Training
records.reason: On-Demand Communication replaces collectives with point-to-point communication to improve device utilization and throughput only for imbalanced LLM post-training; the paper does not target inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: SJD++: Improved Speculative Jacobi Decoding for Training-free Acceleration of Discrete Auto-regressive Text-to-Image Generation
records.reason: Full text scopes SJD++ to discrete autoregressive image-generation models and evaluates image latency/quality; no LLM inference or serving application is demonstrated.

body_review.finding: The method and evaluations are specifically for discrete autoregressive text-to-image generation; no language-model inference system or transfer result is established.

records.title: Streaming Communication in Multi-Agent Reasoning
records.reason: StreamMA pipelines multi-agent reasoning to reduce latency and analyzes communication cost across agent topologies, a systems-level inference improvement.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: streams each reasoning step to downstream agents as soon as it is generated

records.title: Diagnosing Overhead in Dispatch Operations: Cross-architecture Observatory
records.reason: DODOCO measures MoE expert dispatch under realistic routing and shows workload properties that should guide all-to-all interconnect and dispatch design.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: Mock tokens overestimate routing imbalance by up to a factor of 2.35

records.title: Enabling Performant and Flexible Model-Internal Observability for LLM Inference
records.reason: DMI-Lib captures model-internal tensors while preserving serving optimizations and measures low overhead in batch inference and online serving.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: decoupling it from the inference hot path via an asynchronous observability substrate

records.title: Gated Subspace Inference for Transformer Acceleration
records.reason: Gated Subspace Inference skips selected residual work using a low-rank activation representation and reports transformer inference speedups with controlled output error.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: per-token gate that determines whether the residual correction is computed or skipped

records.title: Stochastic Sparse Attention for Memory-Bound Inference
records.reason: SANTA reduces value-cache reads and attention-kernel/decode latency for long-context LLM inference.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: sparsifies value-cache access by sampling S indices from the post-softmax distribution

records.title: Parallelism Strategies and Concurrency Effects for Mixture-of-Experts Inference on GPU Systems
records.reason: The EDAS-hosted SIEDS paper compares tensor, expert, and hybrid parallelism for MoE inference on GPUs, giving concrete system-performance evidence for deployment strategy.
records.primary_source: official conference-hosted primary paper PDF; title/DOI cross-checked against SIEDS program
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: little empirical guidance on which strategy to choose

body_review.finding: The study compares GPU parallel-placement strategies for MoE inference and reports throughput/variance effects; this is directly within inference deployment systems.

records.title: SMoES: Soft Modality-Guided Expert Specialization in MoE-VLMs
records.reason: SMoES aligns MoE-VLM expert routing with modality signals and expert-parallel deployment, reporting lower communication overhead and higher throughput.

records.title: S-HPLB: Efficient LLM Attention Serving via Sparsity-Aware Head Parallelism Load Balance
records.reason: S-HPLB balances sparse attention heads across GPUs to reduce resource bubbles and attention latency in LLM serving.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: 2.88× improvement in average attention computation latency

records.title: BinaryAttention: One-Bit QK-Attention for Vision and Diffusion Transformers
records.reason: The full text evaluates BinaryAttention on vision and diffusion transformers; the paper’s application and experiments are image-generation/vision, without an LLM inference deployment result.

sections_read: Experiments on vision and diffusion transformers
body_review.finding: The method is a one-bit QK attention kernel, but evaluated models/tasks are vision and diffusion transformers; no LLM inference result is reported.

records.title: VectorWeaver: A Stage-Aware Automated Optimization Framework for LLM Inference on Edge Platform
records.reason: The DOI/title metadata identifies a stage-aware RISC-V LLM inference optimization framework, which is directly relevant, but the ACM primary article page returned 403 and no primary abstract/full text was retrievable; retain pending primary-source evidence.
